description: A virtual Anemometer and Weather. Additional: wind speed, temperature display, felt temperature, air humidity, dew point temperature, 4 day preview... Showing weather data: - Wind speed in different units - additional digital display in mb, hPa, Torr, psi or inchHG - Shows the name of the weather station resp. town - Temperature in ?C or ?F - felt temperature - humidity in % - Wind speed in km/h, MPH, kn, m/s or Bft - Wind direction - Date + time of the weather data - Data: Internet, online (a few bytes only) - 4 day preview - Barometer History - Moon phases - Ice Preview - Different Backgroun
